Commentary.Commentary: INDIA IN THE FINAL! The inevitable has happened and the first semi-final between India and England has been CALLED OFF due to incessant rain. By virtue of topping their group, the Women in Blue earn their first-ever ticket to the finale of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. We will now head over to the second semi-final which is to be contested between South Africa and Australia at 1900 local (0800 GMT). The venue remains the same and hence the waiting game will be on once more. A test of patience awaits!
